rules.requirement: overwrite, delete, or prune is authorized only by an exact reviewed first-line generator marker; CRLF normalization may strip only the line-ending carriage return
an absent, altered, suffixed, spaced, or otherwise non-exact marker is consumer-owned and must never authorize destructive regeneration
generated-file ownership never authorizes overwriting or deleting symlinks or special files
stale generated files may be removed only after the same exact ownership check used for overwrite
